Definition: properly, to leap suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to be dismayed
BiblicalUsage: Charag appears once: the strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the close places are the last hiding spots: enemies driven out of them have nowhere left to run.
